scope: Full question-proposal portfolio for the 32 currently inventoried provisional-ID agentic releases. This planning index resolves every question card and records conditional consolidation; it creates no training task or validated coverage. Nine source leads without inventories remain outside the enumerated denominator.
interpretation: Question cards, proposed task groups, benchmark records and implemented tasks are different units. The proposed task count is neither a cap nor a target to instantiate mechanically.
All source card endpoints, scientific caveats, native package requirements and full artifacts are inherited by reference. A group cannot discard any member requirement to fit its title.

Conditional consolidation is a proposed scientific task, not a proved equivalence. If compatible independent inputs, methods and <=30-minute runtime do not exist, split it back into coherent questions and preserve uncovered source IDs.
Do not turn registry configurations, repeated assays, source protocol variants or known aliases into automatic independent workflow credit.
Scientific realism governs task boundaries. One task may use several native tools and produce many intermediate artifacts when they answer one question; unrelated estimands stay separate.

ScholarQA-Bio contributes 1,451 enumerated question identities with unreviewed endpoint dispositions. These have no question-card assignments; source citation attribution uses a learned model, and deterministic numerical extraction does not cover unrestricted synthesis.

LAB-Bench contributes 801 scoped literature/database identities and nine shared family contracts. Supplementary questions have 58 provisional design assignments and 24 explicit gaps; 719 other questions retain endpoint-review gaps. Fifty Biomni DbQA stems overlap, with twenty ambiguous source matches; no additional aliases are credited.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which observed orthologs retain evolutionary signal across two clades after alignment QC, tree rooting and complete per-locus metric comparisons?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use matched alignment/tree pairs from the same original loci; preserve every per-tip, per-pair and per-locus endpoint and rooting definition. Ortholog discovery and de novo tree inference remain separate upstream work.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Orthogroup within clade; taxa are observations within a locus, not extra locus replicates.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Locus/taxon manifest; every alignment metric, branch metric, tip score and pairwise distance; complete paired and unpaired comparisons.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native PhyKIT reference plus independent branch/path sums and site counts; explicit SD, quantile, root, gap and zero-denominator rules.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Drop one low-signal locus; swap tree/alignment identities; corrupt one patristic distance.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Input lineage clearance, actual metric definitions and tolerances; measure full native run.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which single-copy ortholog relationships are supported across independent observed annotated genomes after protein extraction, homology grouping, alignment, trimming and native tree inference?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: One bounded multi-genome collection must support extraction through inference; supplied precomputed orthologs cannot satisfy the discovery endpoints. Keep all requested native methods and complete exclusion records. BioAgent additionally requires all-four-genome coding/confidence filters, consensus functional annotations and an explicit module-grouping rule; BUSCO or gene trees alone do not complete that endpoint.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Species and original gene/orthogroup; duplicated isoforms cannot become independent orthologs.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: FASTA/GFF extraction map; BUSCO calls including failures; all retained/excluded groups; alignment and trimmed-column maps; inferred trees and support.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Run native extraction, BUSCO, BLAST where requested, MAFFT, ClipKIT and chosen tree tool; verify CDS phase/strand, memberships, residues, trimmed columns and leaf sets. Freeze deterministic inference or explicitly accepted topology/score equivalence.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Supply a precomputed ortholog list without discovery; mismatch GFF phase; drop a duplicate hit; attach a tree to another locus.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Compatible compact observed genomes, pinned BUSCO lineage and model; complete pipeline must fit 30 minutes.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which condition-associated gene effects remain when independent observed replicated RNA reads are quantified and analyzed with an explicit count model?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Supply actual paired FASTQ, reference FASTA/GTF and a full-rank replicated sample design; require QC, alignment or declared quantification, complete counts and differential results. Count-only inputs cannot satisfy read-processing coverage.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Independent biological sample; paired reads are technical mates.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: FASTQ pair manifest and QC; SAM/BAM alignment accounting; gene counts; full sample/design/contrast matrices and all gene effects, SE, p and q.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Pinned aligner/counter and DESeq2; independently check read/sample identities, count conservation, design rank, contrast signs and multiplicity.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Swap mates or samples; reverse a contrast; omit filtered genes; treat unreplicated samples as population inference.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent replicated FASTQ/reference/GTF combination; strandedness and count policy; bounded reference/index size.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which replicated expression effects and functional processes remain under explicit count filtering, effect shrinkage, ranked and selected-set enrichment universes?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Keep ranked GSEA and selected-list overrepresentation as distinct outputs with their own universes and multiplicity rules; preserve GO/KEGG version and semantic-reduction requirements. All named native methods must run.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Biological sample for expression; genes/sets are tested features.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Complete gene effects before/after shrinkage; eligible universe and identifier map; GO/KEGG memberships; every ORA/GSEA result and semantic-reduction map; numeric plot data.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native DESeq2 and pinned enrichment methods; independent contrast, overlap, ranking, FDR and universe checks. Freeze ontology release, tie handling, set sizes and undefined-result rules.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Use significant genes as the enrichment background; reverse rank direction; substitute ORA for GSEA; omit nonsignificant sets.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Observed replicated counts, pinned ontology snapshots and exact semantic reduction; prediction/reference set comparison is a separate check within the card.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which observed cell populations and marker programs survive sample-aware QC, normalization and dimensional-representation checks?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Preserve full cell/gene QC, layers and IDs and every requested representation; label-invariant and geometric checks replace raw cluster/embedding equality. PromptBio's SingleR stage remains required where targeted.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Cell within biological sample; sample-level conclusions need biological replication.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Every cell/gene QC decision, layer semantics, feature map, PCA loadings/variance, graph, clusters, embeddings, marker statistics, reference labels and nested lineage membership.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Recompute QC and normalization; check full IDs and PCA reconstruction/subspaces; use label-invariant cluster and geometric checks. Native SingleR, t-SNE and UMAP are separate method outputs where requested.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Read normalized values as raw counts; change mitochondrial denominator; omit excluded cells; relabel clusters without preserving membership.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Count layers, mitochondrial annotation, independent reference and tissue with requested lineage; freeze feature, graph and stochastic method settings.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which cell-type-specific expression effects persist across independently observed paired biological samples under a complete donor-level pseudobulk analysis?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use actual paired donor conditions, multiple eligible cell populations and full gene/contrast outputs. Localization, age, tissue, genotype, sex-interaction and disease-state questions now have separate cards; the former 73-record family grouping does not imply one interchangeable estimand.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Paired donor and cell type; cells contribute counts, not independent donor replicates.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: All cell QC/assignment decisions, cell-type donor counts, pseudobulk gene counts, paired design, every gene/contrast effect and complete uncertainty/test tables.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native specified count model plus independent aggregation, donor pairing, rank/contrast and FDR checks; preserve missing or ineligible donor-celltype combinations explicitly.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Permute donor pairing; fit cells as replicates; omit zero-count genes; reverse the treatment contrast.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent actually paired cohort, cell-type eligibility, feature filter, design, contrast and shrinkage settings.

question_groups.scientific_question: How accurately does a reference-trained native classifier assign observed query-cell identities across independent donors or studies, including ambiguous cells?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Run CellTypist with reference-only training and majority-vote outputs for the Liu endpoint, and separately grade full held-out label predictions. BioXArena prompt details remain unresolved; closed-set and unknown-cell semantics must not be conflated.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Held-out donor/study; query cells never enter reference training.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Feature correspondence, fit/query donor assignment, label hierarchy, classifier predictions/scores, majority votes and all private-label metric counts.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Run native CellTypist; verify training/query separation and label vocabulary; compute full accuracy/confusion and uncertainty endpoints from private labels. Reference-derived truth must be labeled as such.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Leak query labels into fitting; omit unknown populations; majority-vote across unrelated sample groups; drop difficult cells.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent reference and query annotations; source-specific unknown-label policy; BioXArena full prompts are still unavailable.

question_groups.scientific_question: How well does a native paired-modality model predict independently withheld observed protein measurements from RNA across biological samples?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use actual paired measurements and antibody-background controls; keep withheld values private and separate donors in fitting/tuning/evaluation. Run the specific native model required by Liu; BioXArena full schemas remain pending.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Donor and paired cell; no random-cell substitute for donor generalization.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Cell and antibody maps, raw/normalized layers, donor fit/query assignment, totalVI settings, complete predicted protein matrix and per-protein metrics.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native totalVI oracle; identity/layer checks and metrics against private paired measurements. Reject missing or constant target columns explicitly; undefined correlation must not earn the source scorer midpoint.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Expose query ADT to fitting; permute antibody IDs; output constants; omit proteins with poor predictions.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Paired donor data and background controls, scale-specific evaluation, frozen baseline threshold and bounded training time; BioXArena schemas pending.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which weighted coexpression modules in independent observed biological samples associate with condition and retain reproducible hub membership?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use biological samples as observations and pin WGCNA network, power, module and correlation conventions. Pairwise thresholded-correlation outputs are additional endpoints, not substitutes for weighted-network construction.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Independent spinal-cord sample with documented disease status; genes are network nodes.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Sample QC, transformation, all tested powers, weighted network definition, module assignments/eigengenes, membership, trait tests and separate thresholded edges/hubs.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native WGCNA; independently check correlations, module sizes, eigengene reconstruction up to sign and multiplicity. Freeze signedness, power criterion, merge rule and module-label invariance.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Replace WGCNA with a thresholded graph; count cells as spinal-cord subjects; reverse eigengene sign without updating trait effects.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent disease-relevant spinal-cord cohort with enough subjects; full gene/network memory bound and stable module acceptance.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which expression-defined patient groups remain stable under prespecified resampling and associate with independently measured pathology?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Keep clinical outcomes out of cluster-number selection; output consensus assignments, stability and separate outcome associations. Model-specific consensus requirements remain mandatory.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Patient; repeated specimens stay together during resampling and evaluation.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Input transform, PCA, every resample/split, cluster-label matching, consensus opportunities/agreements, memberships, factor-rank results, pathway and pathology tests.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native specified clustering/factorization; independently reconstruct consensus denominators and held-out membership predictions. Freeze label-invariant acceptance and keep pathology out of rank/cluster selection.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Use pathology to choose K; omit failed resamples; divide agreement by all iterations instead of pair co-occurrence.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent liver expression with pathology; source underspecified bootstrap/train-test policy must be frozen; bounded complete resampling run.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which observed gene-level screen effects and pathways remain after guide-count QC, negative controls and replication across screen rounds?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Run guide QC, replicate/round-aware gene effects and requested enrichment on independent observed screen counts. Literature-based screen-context retrieval is a separate question; numerical hit calls alone do not resolve its evidence requirements.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Guide within gene, biological replicate and observed screen round.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Full guide counts and identities, negative-control roles, normalization factors, guide/gene effect tables, round/replicate summaries and complete tested pathways.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native screen method plus independent guide mapping, library totals, replicate contrasts and set membership checks; pin null controls and multiple-testing universe.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Pool biological rounds before the requested comparison; treat guides as independent biological replicates; omit negative controls or failed guides.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent observed screen with requested rounds/replication; exact guide-to-gene exclusions, enrichment universe and native method.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which observed protein abundance effects remain after explicit assay-scale normalization, missingness and paired biological-sample testing?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Select an independently observed paired assay; retain peptide/protein mapping and the complete tested-protein universe. An intensity-table task does not exercise raw spectral search.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Patient pair; peptides map to proteins under a frozen grouping rule.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Sample/patient map, measured/missing intensities and scale, normalization factors, every protein effect/uncertainty/test and ranked result.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Pinned proteomics model; independent pairing, scale transformation, mean/effect and multiplicity checks. Freeze missing-not-at-random treatment rather than replacing all absent intensities by zero.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Lose patient pairing; log already logged values; silently impute zero; return only significant proteins.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Observed paired abundance study, protein inference/measurement provenance, explicit missing-value policy and complete tested universe.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which independently measured RNA and protein effects agree after sample, identity, scale and direction reconciliation?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use genuinely matched biological samples or explicitly comparable independent contrasts; preserve distinct assay models and full pathway/membership tables. Do not correlate unmatched subjects.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Matched subject or explicitly comparable independent contrast; identifier aliases are not new features.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: RNA/protein identity and isoform map, eligible matched universe, separate full assay effects, joint directions/ranks, correlation/uncertainty and pathway memberships.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Compute each assay model separately; independently check join multiplicity, contrast signs, correlation and prespecified joint-signal formula.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Correlate unmatched patients; mix linear and log effects; duplicate a protein-to-gene mapping; flip one contrast.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Observed comparable contrasts, one-to-many identity policy, joint-effect scale and pathway combination rule.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which observed clonotypes expand or recur across biological samples and associate with independently measured transcriptional states after chain and cell-identity QC?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Keep this TCR/RNA question separate from BCR V/J assignment. Preserve cell/donor identities, CD8 sorting evidence where source-required, and full chain/state/clone outputs. Raw-read assembly needs observed reads; a supplied-contig start covers downstream analysis only. A developmental cohort does not establish tumor-exhaustion or cancer-response endpoints.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Observed paired receptor chains and RNA from the same cells, grouped by donor/sample.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Complete barcode/sample/chain/productivity map, receptor QC, paired clonotypes, expansion/sharing denominators, RNA states, all clone-state associations and sort-gate evidence where required.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native receptor tools on their required input boundary; independently reconstruct chain pairing, clone membership and full denominators. Distinguish observed transcriptional labels from experimental sorting and cancer context.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Pair chains across cells; collapse identical barcodes across donors; count cells as donors; infer tumor exhaustion from an unrelated developmental cohort.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent paired TCR/RNA study with actual required sorting/disease metadata; observed reads are mandatory for any claimed raw-read assembly.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which assembly contiguity and proposed joins are supported by independent observed reads and reference agreement?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Retain all contigs, read evidence, join decisions and complete error summaries. Extend the existing observed PhiX candidate only if it supports the new endpoints; current N50 validation does not prove join evaluation.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Original contig and observed read pair; overlapping fragments are not independent genomes.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: All contig sequences/lengths, length-weighted N50, read alignments/coverage, every proposed overlap/join with evidence and full mismatch/base totals.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native assembly/alignment where claimed; independently recompute N50, join orientation/extent and error denominators. A reference alignment and read support are distinct evidence.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Use the median contig length for N50; reverse a join; drop mismatches; use unsupported duplicate fragments to inflate coverage.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Observed assembly with informative contig joins; existing PhiX N50 evidence alone does not validate this expanded task.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which versioned protein entries and attributes in an independent frozen graph agree with their source records, and which are obsolete, contradicted or unresolved?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use the same frozen graph and source exports for entry and field reconciliation. Protein-sequence candidate ranking remains separate; literature entailment and biological absence are not established by structured joins.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Versioned protein accession and isoform within species/source release.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: All queried identifiers, aliases, version history, node presence, source attributes, field-level agreements/contradictions and scoped unknown states.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Exact frozen joins and field comparison with provenance. Explicit evidence rules distinguish absent fields, obsolete records and absent entries; no unrestricted literature-entailment credit.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Treat missing graph node as biological nonexistence; merge species/isoforms; drop contradictory fields.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent frozen graph/source export and machine-checkable predicates; open literature claims remain an uncovered objective.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which directed biological interaction claims are supported by frozen independent evidence with compatible entity, assay and context identities?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Verify full typed directed edges and source evidence under a prespecified rule, including unresolved claims. Structural citation matching alone cannot satisfy literature entailment or biological absence claims. Biomni DBQA asks for prediction-resource membership. Keep a separate prediction-membership table and acceptance predicate; experimental support or graph direction cannot replace that endpoint. If one independent resource bundle cannot support both questions, split the group.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Typed entity pair, relation and experimental context in a frozen evidence release.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Complete query/entity map, every candidate directed edge, evidence/source identifiers, context, support class and unresolved/contradicted states.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Independently recompute directed typed joins under explicit evidence rules; citations must point to correct entries. Grade structured predicates only, with no inference from citation presence to entailment.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Reverse an edge; substitute predicted association for measured interaction; turn missing evidence into a negative experimental result.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent evidence exports, relation-specific rules and exact coverage limit for source literature questions. Resolve Biomni prediction-resource membership separately from BioKGBench relation evidence; do not assume prediction records are observations or interactions are causal directed edges.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which ligand identities and protein contacts are supported by independently observed complex coordinates after assembly and alternate-location reconciliation?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Require actual ligand coordinates, component identity, atom/residue mapping and complete distance/contact outputs. Protein-DNA interface accounting is a separate task; a ligand-only structure cannot supply nucleic-acid contacts.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Observed complex/assembly, chain, residue and ligand atom with model/alternate-location identity.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: mmCIF/PDB and component manifest, assembly transforms, complete selected atom/residue map, ligand identity/bonds, all required distances/contacts and exclusions.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native structure parser/chemistry tool plus independent coordinate-distance calculations; freeze occupancy/alternate-location rules, contact cutoffs, waters/metals and ligand identity criteria.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Use asymmetric-unit coordinates for a biological-assembly claim; confuse residue and atom indices; merge alternate conformers; substitute a protein-DNA contact.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent observed complex with unambiguous ligand and required biological assembly; exact chemical identity and contact definitions.

question_groups.scientific_question: Do structure-derived rankings and a bounded predictive model agree with independently measured ligand affinity across held-out scaffolds and protein families?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use measured affinities linked to observed structures, explicit units/censoring and target/scaffold-held-out evaluation; preserve each native model and full prediction schema. Mechanistic pose/force-field affinity hypotheses now have a separate question and cannot be collapsed into a generic prediction metric.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Measured target-ligand assay, with target-family/scaffold groups for held-out evaluation.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Structure/ligand/assay joins, units and censoring, full fit/query group map, feature/model configuration, every affinity prediction and complete ranking/regression sufficient statistics.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native baseline checks feasibility; independently validate assay identity, unit conversion, grouping and frozen metrics against private measured affinity. Prediction scores do not establish mechanistic binding explanations.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Mix IC50 with Kd without a declared model; leak a scaffold/target family; expose query affinity; drop censored or poorly predicted compounds.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent measured structure/affinity collection, compatible assay semantics, bounded native model and metric acceptance; BioXArena full prompt pending.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which population structure, relatedness and frequency findings remain after observed genotype and sample QC?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Retain unrelated-reference selection, ancestry uncertainty, complete tested sites and all source equilibrium/outlier tests. Population labels and genetic ancestry are distinct variables.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Participant; related individuals are retained for kinship but controlled in population-reference estimation.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: VCF allele/sample eligibility, genotype counts, full pairwise kinship/IBS, reference selection, PCs, uncertainty, all site frequency/HWE/Fst components and outlier decisions.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Pinned genotype tools plus independent allele-count, missingness and Fst denominator checks; verify relationship classes and projection against frozen definitions. Genetic ancestry and reported population labels remain separate.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Swap reference alleles without dosage recoding; train ancestry axes on duplicates; drop monomorphic sites silently; replace weighted Fst with mean site ratios.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independently licensed VCF/reference cohort with relatedness evidence; estimator, LD pruning, uncertainty and outlier criteria.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which observed cell-type neighborhoods recur across tissue sections under physical-coordinate and section-aware null models?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Use independent observed sections with measured spatial coordinates and biological/section identities. Preserve density, boundary and null-stratum semantics. Within-volume 3D counting has a separate question; one volume or two different anatomical samples cannot establish replicated between-condition inference.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Cell within section and biological subject; neighborhood edges are dependent observations.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Coordinate/cell-type/sample manifest, complete graph edges, every tested type pair, observed/expected counts, null strata, effect/statistic/p/q and section-level summaries.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native specified spatial methods plus independent distance/graph and type-pair counts; freeze physical radius, boundary policy, density correction and within-section null.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Use UMAP coordinates; permute across subjects; treat one volume as replicated conditions; omit depleted/nonsignificant pairs.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent replicated sections with physical coordinates and cell identities; eligibility, null and section-to-subject aggregation rules.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which genes, modules and domains show reproducible observed spatial structure under explicit neighborhood and multiplicity definitions?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: The BioML source's synthetic spatial example must be adapted to independent observed sections. Run named native autocorrelation/module methods and retain complete gene/module/domain outputs; distinct nulls are not interchangeable.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Biological section/subject; spots are spatially dependent observations.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Coordinate and count manifest, neighborhood/weight matrices, every gene statistic/p/q, null settings, ranked genes, domain membership and Hotspot module scores.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native named autocorrelation and Hotspot methods; independently check coordinate/feature joins, graph weights, FDR and ranking. Each null/normalization is recorded separately.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Use embedding coordinates as physical positions; omit nonsignificant genes; shuffle between unrelated sections; substitute one method p-value for another.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Observed sections, physical units and appropriate replication; replace the BioML synthetic source openly, without claiming the same data distribution.

question_groups.scientific_question: How do eligible observed methylation sites distribute across chromosomes after unique-site and accessible-space accounting?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Specify whether the denominator is total chromosome length or measured/callable bases for each endpoint; retain both if needed, with distinct tests. Selected extreme sites and all eligible sites are different populations.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Unique genomic CpG and biological sample; repeated probes/sites must be reconciled.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: BED coordinate map, all eligibility/age/extreme flags, sample methylated/total counts where available, callable/reference lengths and separate chromosome tests.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Independent unique-site counts, coordinate convention, density and expected-count reconstruction; freeze methylation, age-association and extreme thresholds.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Use chromosome length in a callable-space test; count duplicate sites twice; replace all eligible sites by significant extremes.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent age-annotated methylation observations plus reference/callability evidence; exact test and multiplicity rules.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which structures, energies and base-pair probabilities follow from an independent observed RNA sequence under a pinned native folding model?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Predicted structures are computational outputs, not observed biological truth. Require all MFE, ensemble and pairing-probability endpoints and units; experimental agreement needs separate measured structure evidence.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Versioned complete transcript/isoform.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Accession/sequence provenance, FASTA, all dot-bracket/MFE/ensemble outputs, full pairing-probability data, units and plot data.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Native pinned folding tool/parameters; check sequence identity, bracket validity, base-pair indexing and probability bounds/sums. Freeze temperature, constraints and pseudoknot scope.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Fold a truncated transcript; shift pair indices; report energy in wrong units; present predicted pairs as observed structure.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent observed sequences and exact isoforms; length/runtime bounds and thermodynamic model.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which image-derived predictions recover independently recorded lesion classes across held-out patients and acquisition sources?
question_groups.condition_for_one_task: Reconcile label taxonomies and source metric/positive-class definitions, retain all subject IDs and probabilities, and use independent licensed observations. Source prompt equivalence and bounded compute remain pending.

acceptance_planning_review.biological_unit: Patient and lesion; multiple views of a lesion stay together.
acceptance_planning_review.complete_artifacts: Image/patient/lesion manifest, label dictionary, fit/query groups, full class probabilities and predictions, confusion counts and all source metrics.
acceptance_planning_review.deterministic_acceptance: Compute metrics against private observed diagnostic labels, including positive-class conventions and probabilities. Check label provenance, class imbalance and a frozen baseline.
acceptance_planning_review.required_incorrect_output_checks: Split alternate views across fit/query; invert positive label; omit rare classes; return labels when probabilities are required.
acceptance_planning_review.unresolved_before_assignment: Independent licensed images and recorded diagnostic evidence; source prompt taxonomy and bounded model weights/runtime.

question_groups.scientific_question: Which cell populations are enriched in an independently collected tumor cohort relative to adjacent tissue and blood across donors?
Are baseline immune-cell fractions associated with a later measured treatment response across independent patients?
How do sequence composition and fixed predictor scores distinguish independently labeled protein assembly classes?
